command.path_normalization: The actual command used local absolute paths to these exact authority/submission bytes and the full public-Git object database. This portable record substitutes repository-relative paths and a private decoded-object output path. The retained proof is a minimized subset; unchanged evaluate_completion was rerun against it at the actual observation time and produced the identical result. No test/gate result is inferred from path normalization.

limitations: Authenticated collection and identity attestations are caller responsibilities; this evaluator never fetches, dispatches, changes ownership or accepts work on its own.
This is actual isolated repair evidence acceptance at the stated time, not scoped live admission for other tasks, global IDLE, or deployment permission.
Authority freshness expires. A current action requires fresh authenticated authority, exact candidate binding and preserved ownership/stops.
No private session/queue observations or private identities are included. Git objects are already-public source, rule, execution and review objects.
